fusions.name: Nursery Chirp
fusions.desc: Sends a chirp into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 resonating damage. Its damage rises with every ally near you. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Matriarch's Descent
fusions.desc: Dives onto the target, dealing 30 blunt damage, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds, and a further 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Huddle Warmth
fusions.desc: Restores 12 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles. Using it increases your movement speed by 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Kindred Siphon
fusions.desc: When you are healed, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
